newsitem.title: USA: Supergen says Ellison to buy stock for $15m.
newsitem.headline: Supergen says Ellison to buy stock for $15m.

text.p: SuperGen Inc said Tuesday it agreed that an investment entity owned by Oracle Corp founder and chairman Larry Ellison would purchase $15 million in Supergen common stock at $9 a share in a private placement.
SuperGen also said it has offered Ellison a seat on the board of directors.

The agreement gives Ellison the right to buy an additional $8 million in common stock at the same price until the end of October. The terms also include warrants to purchase an additional $17 million of common stock at $13.50 a share.

SuperGen chairman and chief executive officer Joseph Rubenfeld said the investment would allow the emerging pharmaceutical company's senior management to "concentrate on product development and commercialization rather than raising capital."
